newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds easier in patchy trading.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds easier in patchy trading.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were mostly lower on Thursday following the easier overnight close in Chicago.
Soymeal sellers were one to three stg lower for high protein while Brazils were three stg down.
Rapemeal was one stg down for old crop ex-mill Erith while new crop was unchanged.
In Liverpool and Hull crop was unchanged and new crop around one stg down.
Sunflower pellets and meal and corn gluten feed pellets were unchanged.
In Patchy trading wheat feed meal ex-mill in the Midlands fetched 82 stg for spot.

Brazilian 48's traded ex-store Teignmouth at 209 stg for second half May while in Avonmouth corn distillers fetched 119.50 stg a tonne for spot ex-store on the resale market. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
